label.title: Label
label.description: The variable's name, as node config values reference it (`${project:<label>}`) and scripts read it (`linkiir.config.project().<label>`). Letters, digits, `_`, `.` and `-`, not starting with a digit.

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Whether this entry holds a secret value.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: Full list of variables to save for the project, replacing any existing ones.

force.title: Force
force.description: Save even though nodes reference a variable this removes, renames, or makes secret. Without it, such a save is refused with 409 and the usages it would break.
